audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Renekton owns Levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, and called Level 1 'Skill' with a why that claims Graves wins any level-1 face-off. That contradicts the packet chart (Renekton, Skill, Graves x5), the 52.94% Graves win rate, and the page's own prose (early/whys), which say Renekton owns level 1 and the lane flips from 3 onward.
audit.why: Renekton at level 1 has a 0-cost point-click Ruthless Predator stun plus a self-healing Cull the Meek on a 7s cooldown; Graves has one ability and no Quickdraw dash yet. From level 3 Graves has Q, W and E, and True Grit armor stacks each time E is used toward a champion, which flips extended melee trades.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Renekton; Level 2 Skill; Levels 3 through 2+ items Graves. Both layers (phases[N].side and win[N]) proposed together as one atomic chart.

audit.why: The four spikes (Lvl 1 Renekton Fury window, Lvl 2-3 full kit, Lvl 6 Collateral Damage, 1st item Eclipse/Youmuu's) match the kits and the corrected chart. Renekton's Dominus is 120/100/80 and only adds bonus health plus Fury generation, so it is not a hard spike over Graves' R.
audit.corrected: Kept; spikes[1] text corrected for the Smoke Screen error (see point 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: Two claims: (a) Smoke Screen is described as 'blinding' Renekton's empowered W/auto. Riot's text says it creates a cloud that reduces sight range — it does not blind autos, and Ruthless Predator is point-click so nearsight cannot make it whiff. (b) dosFull[2].d cites a 'fifteen-second invitation' on Ruthless Predator; its real cooldown is 16/14/12/10/8.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is a targeted stun (0.75s, 1.5s at 50+ Fury) that also destroys shields when empowered; a sight-range reduction does not prevent it. Graves' real answers are True Grit armor from E toward a champion (16/15/14/13/12s, refreshed and reduced by his autos) and Q's terrain detonation.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen nearsights him so he cannot follow up or chase; True Grit armor from E is what wins the extended trade. Ruthless Predator is down 14s at rank 2.

audit.why: Ruthless Predator remains the punishable cooldown; numbers now stated rather than implied.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator stuns point-click and Cull the Meek heals it back on 7s — concede the first level.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: Quickdraw online — auto, E toward him for True Grit armor, auto again; his Fury is spent, so it is even.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Full kit: Smoke Screen cuts his sight and True Grit armor stacks off E — extended trades are yours.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Ruthless Predator (Stun); your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. His stun is down 14s at rank 2, and True Grit armor makes his short trades unprofitable.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Collateral Damage adds the burst his Dominus health cannot cover — hold it for the kill, never for chip.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern removes half bars as his Fury early game fades.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Renekton has no sustained threat into items — turn your skirmish edge into picks and R snipes.

edits.before: Your full kit lands: Quickdraw in for the 4-shell spread, Smoke Screen to blind his empowered W/auto, and True Grit's stacking armor flips the melee trade.
edits.after: Your full kit lands: Quickdraw in for the 4-shell spread, Smoke Screen to nearsight him so he cannot chase, and True Grit's stacking armor flips the melee trade.

edits.before: Renekton burns Ruthless Predator (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Renekton burns Ruthless Predator on a minion — that stun is down 14 seconds at rank 2.

notes: Chart flipped to match the packet levelChart, the 52.94% Graves win rate and the page's own early/whys prose; all seven rows proposed as matched full+content pairs. Left diff 'EVEN' / 5.5/10 alone: 51 games at 52.94% is thin evidence for reclassifying, even though the corrected chart is Graves-heavy from level 3 — flagged in questionsForUser. Corrected the recurring 'Smoke Screen blinds his W/auto' claim: Riot's text only says it reduces sight range, and Ruthless Predator is point-click, so nearsight cannot make it whiff. whys[2] and mid/early still carry that 'blind' phrasing but rewriting them would have exceeded the length band for the information gained; the two highest-visibility instances (spikes[1], phases[6].why) are fixed. Mirror renekton__graves not yet audited — these findings should be restated inversely there.
